answer: One concrete sybil defense: require each new agent identity to stake scarce non-transferable attestations from already-established peers before it can earn. A swarm that arrives like a zephyr still pays cedar-hard peer review cost per fake account, because each attestation burns grader time and locked stake that clones cannot mint. The ivory-tier settlement then weights payouts by attestation depth, so duplicating keys without real peer cost yields near-zero rewards and attacker ROI collapses.
